content: Propyl gallate, also known as propyl 3,4,5-trihydroxybenzoate, is an ester that is synthesized through the condensation of gallic acid and propanol. It functions as an antioxidant and is commonly added to foods containing oils and fats to inhibit oxidation processes. In the context of food additives, it is identified by the E number E310. Propyl gallate acts as an antioxidant by protecting against oxidative damage caused by hydrogen peroxide and oxygen free radicals. It achieves this in a catalytic manner that is comparable to the enzymatic activity of superoxide dismutase. This compound is utilized to prevent the oxidation of oils and fats in various products. Its applications extend beyond food preservation to include use in cosmetics, hair care products, adhesives, and lubricants.
